title: An unexpected signer
change: chain.jsonl, manifest.json and bill.json are a complete, self-consistent bundle for the same August outcomes, signed by a different demo key (kid sb:issuer:C4T82bZnZxSY, fingerprint sha256:3c5001f87c1d6bd0d1377866e0b3c01e037fd57ad4aede1f89b0808ba06c3d03). supplied-keys.json is the keys document that came with that bundle, naming that key. The consumer is given the pinned keys document (../../keys.json), as in every case.
why: Keys: the records name a key the pinned keys document does not hold. Every record verifies under the self-supplied key and none under the pinned one, so a consumer that took the bundle's own keys document would pass this bundle.
